profile_text.body:
Runway is a for-profit AI startup founded in 2018 and headquartered in New York, NY, with a newly announced European headquarters in London. The company describes itself as building foundational "Real-World Intelligence" that can understand, simulate, and act in the world, with products and services layered on top of that foundation. Its core technical offering is GWM-1, which it calls a state-of-the-art General World Model, and it applies that model across capabilities including policy inference and evaluation and synthetic data generation. The company also offers the Runway Dev platform, which includes the Runway Media Router, described as the first preference-optimized router for generative media. Runway has announced a planned $100 million investment in the UK AI ecosystem alongside the London expansion.

Runway's primary tracked product is its video generation platform at runwayml.com, placed in the Video Generation and Editing category. The company is named in four separate federal lawsuits, including cases brought by David Vance Gardner in both the Southern District of New York and the Central District of California, as well as suits filed by Businessing LLC and Ace Cam, Inc. in the Southern District of New York. Runway is also listed as a defendant in Andersen v. Stability AI Ltd., a case in the Northern District of California. The site's records log 321 legal exposure entries tied to New York.
